The finite positive weighted sum of quantiles strictly decreases with uniform two-sided slopes, so bracketing produces the unique locally Lipschitz mass root. The weighted shifted margins vanish at every point over z, including cap boundaries. At least one nonnegative margin gives a closed containing cap of exactly the new mass.
